join.cardinality: one decision-contract feature row to one decision-contract label row
join.unmatched_feature_row: retain feature row with label_join_present=false; it is unavailable for supervised loss but remains part of runtime-population accounting

timing.decision_time_legality: intent masks use only executable A_t and causal state through t
timing.fill_time_legality: after one exact contract is selected, e=t+1 rechecks identity/freshness, premium floor, affordability, D48, and D49 using A_e
timing.rejected_fill: no position, premium, fee, or realized PnL; retain an explicit failed-fill event and do not create a path label
timing.forced_flat: exact 15:55 state with zero option value if no executable bid

entry_outcome_join.intent_eligible_at_t: causal action-population field computed without labels or t+1 information
entry_outcome_join.fill_recheck_pass_at_tplus1: post-selection execution outcome; never an input to the decision-t composer or live-style comparator
entry_outcome_join.realized_entry_label_present: true only for the selected exact intent when fill_recheck_pass_at_tplus1=true
entry_outcome_join.failed_fill_population_accounting: retain with zero realized policy PnL and no fee in serial denominators; label losses are unavailable rather than zero-imputed
entry_outcome_join.hindsight_oracle_boundary: an explicitly labeled oracle ceiling may inspect future outcomes, but reports intent opportunities and recheck rejections separately and never calls a t+1 outcome an intent mask

no_bid.primary: full-loss state with option value zero
no_bid.mnar_sensitivity: materialize a separately named no-bid-excluded diagnostic view and require policy-rank stability before acceptance

runtime_label_firewall.runtime_horizon_availability: causal clock and model-output availability only; never future target availability
runtime_label_firewall.blocking_rule: exact membership in the frozen label schema and label partition

encoding.dollar_values: int64 cents where exact; float32 model view only after explicit training join

rebuild_reproducibility.logical_content_hash: sha256 over frozen little-endian values, UTF-8 identities, and validity bitmaps in sorted order
